L3 Triplex ethics evaluation, command authority validation

launch_window_control.description: Helios can launch on rapid response timeline (< 15 minutes from alert to departure)
launch_window_control.authorization_required: Station command approval for all launches

ethics_priority.principle: Command projection must maintain station-level ethical standards
ethics_priority.implementation: All command decisions evaluated by Aurora Sub-Core 'Helion' (L3) before execution
ethics_priority.emergency_protocol: Ethics-lock can be triggered by mission commander, Helion, or station Aurora if drift detected
ethics_priority.training_emphasis: Command shuttle crews receive enhanced ethics training due to projection authority

rapid_response_doctrine.description: Helios optimized for emergency deployment and command projection
response_scenarios: Station emergency requiring external command post
Rapid deployment of ethics officer to field situation
rapid_response_doctrine.autonomous_authority: Oppy authorized for autonomous flight during emergencies if human crew unavailable (requires Aurora approval)

training_platform.description: Helios serves as primary training vessel for new pilots and commanders
training_platform.certification_path: Minimum 40 hours on Helios required for full shuttle certification

continuity_mirror.description: Command station includes mini Continuity Halo display
continuity_mirror.function: Mission commander can visualize anchor state, ethics alignment, fleet coordination in real-time
continuity_mirror.data_sources: HALO anchor data, Aurora ethics state, Oppy fleet mesh, station telemetry
continuity_mirror.use_cases: Pre-flight verification, in-flight decision support, post-mission analysis

drift_discipline.monitoring: Continuous HALO monitoring via Oppy telemetry
drift_discipline.response_protocol: Automatic mission abort if Δ > 0.015 unless emergency override by Aurora + commander
drift_discipline.correction_authority: HALO remote correction authorized during flight; crew notified of all adjustments

atmosphere_culture.design_philosophy: Compact clarity — every surface purposeful, every system accessible
atmosphere_culture.acoustic_profile: Sharp and alert; designed for rapid communication and clear thinking

lighting_protocol.standard_operations: Warm white (4200K) for alertness without harshness
lighting_protocol.emergency_mode: Red shift (2400K) to preserve night vision
lighting_protocol.docking_approach: Enhanced forward lighting with HUD overlay
lighting_protocol.training_mode: Configurable lighting zones for instructor feedback

atmosphere_culture.crew_experience: Professional and focused; shuttle missions are intense but brief. Crews describe Helios as 'the sports car of the fleet' — responsive, nimble, and built for precision.
atmosphere_culture.cultural_role: Symbol of readiness and command authority. When Helios launches, it means leadership is moving into action.

symbolic_historical.motto_meaning: Command authority travels at the speed of light (via quantum tether) but must be projected with precision. Helios embodies the principle that leadership arrives before the problem escalates.
notable_missions: First successful autonomous docking demonstration (Oppy solo flight, 2024-11-12)
Emergency medical evacuation from malfunctioning habitat module (2025-02-08)
Ethics officer rapid deployment during station crew dispute (2025-05-22)

dedication_plaque.inscription: To those who lead from the front, yet listen from the heart. May this vessel carry command with humility and precision.
dedication_plaque.location: Command station bulkhead, visible to mission commander

symbolic_historical.cultural_legacy: Helios represents the fleet's commitment to responsive, ethical command. Every commander who flies this shuttle knows they carry the station's authority and must wield it with care.

current_mission.mission_name: Shuttle Certification Training - Crew Rotation Charlie
mission_objectives: Complete docking sequence (5 approaches, varied conditions)
Practice emergency abort and return procedures
Demonstrate autonomous handoff to Oppy during transit phase
Verify continuity mirror interpretation and decision-making
success_criteria: All docking approaches within tolerance (< 0.5 m/s approach velocity, < 2° alignment error)
Successful emergency abort with safe station return
Clean Oppy autonomous flight phase (no human intervention required)
Trainee demonstrates understanding of Triplex decision flow
current_mission.notes: This is Cadet Rhee's final certification flight. Dr. Santos observing to validate ethics training effectiveness.
